description: Prepare the active repository for CodeGraph indexing.

hooks.command: (grep -qxE '[.]codegraph[[:space:]]*' "$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude)" || { echo; echo .codegraph; } >> "$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude)") >&2
hooks.statusMessage: Configuring CodeGraph exclusion for Git checkout root
